bottleneck.name: Adeline Street at Shattuck Avenue / Ward Street

_provenance.methodology: v4.11 ΔT — Standard 1 passes (85 ≥ 15). Standard 3 zone=non_fhsz. Standard 4: project_vehicles = 85 × 1.9 × 0.90 = 145.4 (rounded 145); bottleneck eff_cap = 1900 vph (HCM 2022 multilane × 1.00 non-FHSZ degradation); ΔT = (145 / 1900) × 60 = 4.59 min; threshold = 120 min safe_egress_window × 0.05 max_project_share = 6.00 min. ΔT < threshold → MINISTERIAL_WITH_STANDARD_CONDITIONS.
_provenance.notes: Validates Standard 4 pass on a non-FHSZ multilane corridor. Stories=3 means no NFPA 101 egress penalty (threshold_stories=4).
